title: SI NO. 3 of 2026 SUPPLIES CONTROL (PRICES)(AMENDMENT)(NO.42) REGULATIONS, 2025
text:
No. 3] Supplies Control 1
BELIZE:
STATUTORY INSTRUMENT
No. 3 of 2026
______________
REGULATIONS made by the Minister responsible for
Supplies Control in exercise of the powers conferred upon
him by section 3 of the Supplies Control Act, Chapter
293 of the Substantive Laws of Belize, Revised Edition
2020, and all other powers thereunto him enabling.
(Gazetted 10th January, 2026)
______________
1. These Regulations may be cited as the Citation.
SUPPLIES CONTROL (PRICES) (AMENDMENT)
(NO. 42) REGULATIONS, 2025
and shall be read and construed as one with the Supplies Sub. Leg, 2020
Control (Prices) Regulations, which, as amended, are Edn. CAP. 293
p.49
hereinafter referred to as the principal Regulations.
2. The principal Regulations are amended in Part D of Amendment of
First Schedule.
the First Schedule by repealing the retail prices for the
items, Kerosene, Diesel, Gasoline (Regular) and Gasoline
(Premium), and substituting the following, effective 13th
December, 2025.
“1. Kerosene per U.S. Gallon
(4/5 Imperial Gallon)............................$8.97
2. Diesel per U.S. Gallon
(4/5 Imperial Gallon)..........................$11.67

2 Supplies Control [No. 3
3. Gasoline (Regular) per U.S. Gallon
(4/5 Imperial Gallon)........................$11.63
4. Gasoline (Premium) per U.S. Gallon
(4/5 Imperial Gallon).........................$13.03”.
Negative 3. These Regulations are subject to negative resolution.
Resolution.
MADE this 29th day of December, 2025.
(HON. RODWELL FERGUSON)
Minister of Agriculture, Food Security and
New Growth Industries
(Minister responsible for Supplies Control)
